title: Extra Enchants
description: Mod which adds 18 enchantments to the game
body:
**Extra Enchants** is a lightweight vanilla-like mod that expands the enchantment system in Minecraft 1.21+. Also this mod adds a unique gameplay mechanic involving enchantments, as well as new passive effects for equipment.

[![Fabric Api](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0268889a033bcf91b471edd30423de48982daeb_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

![Loader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/497a72575789b326d74bda2b839cd24cc4d20a5d.png)
![Environment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6ef656c95d89f93a16d7b4660f42ff987bb8414.png)

Mod _adds_ **10** _new weapon enchantments,_ **3** _pickaxe enchantments,_ **3** _armor enchantments, and_ **2** _curses, giving you more ways to customize your gear and enhance your gameplay experience_.

<details>
<summary> Sword </summary>
  
 **Wither**  [2 levels] – Hitting a target with melee attacks applies Wither and drains their life force
 
**Blessed** [3 levels] - While holding a sword, restores your health at regular intervals (the interval decreases with higher levels)

**Webbing** - Places a cobweb at the target's location after a successful hit

**XP Master Sword** [3 levels] - Hitting an enemy has a chance to grant bonus experience, with the amount increasing based on the enchantment level

</details>

<details>
<summary> Trident </summary>

**Poseidon's Blessing**  – When standing in rain or underwater, increases attack speed and grants Dolphin's Grace while holding a trident
 
 **Forsaken Flame**  – Grants Fire Resistance while holding a trident

 **Wither**  [2 levels] – Hitting a target with melee attacks applies Wither and drains their life force
 
  **Fury of the Depths**  – When you or your target in rain or water, melee hits briefly stagger the target, resetting their attack cooldown for a moment {Trident}

 **Echo of Abyss**  [2 levels] – Killing a creature with a trident deals pure damage in an area around it (radius scales with level) and applies Blindness for 1 second to all entities around in radius

 **Mark of Light** – Once per minute, hitting an enemy with a thrown trident makes him glow for 15 seconds

**XP Master Trident** [3 levels] - Hitting an enemy has a chance to grant bonus experience, with the amount increasing based on the enchantment level

### Curses

 **Curse of Salted Rust**  – The trident slowly loses durability when not in water. However, you can never be affected by the Glowing effect
 
 **Curse of Fatigue**  – Applies constant Hunger, when not in water. However, you can never be affected by the Levitation effect

</details>

<details>
 <summary> Pickaxe </summary>
  
**TNT Miner** -  Mining a block creates an explosion at its location

**Mining 3x3** - Mines a 3×3 area instead of a single block, based on the direction you're looking

**XP Master Pickaxe** [3 levels] - Mining blocks has a chance to grant bonus experience, with the amount increasing based on the enchantment level
</details>

<details>
  <summary> Armor </summary>
  
**Life Force** [5 levels] - Increases your maximum health based on the enchantment level {Chestplate}

**Springy** [2 levels] - Increases your jump height based on the enchantment level {Boots}

**Savior** - Upon death, creates an Armor Stand holding the armor you were wearing {Helmet}
</details>
 
I will add a configuration file later that allows you to remove unwanted enchantments
